title: CROSS+WALKRI Family Release Snapshot Manifest v0.1.0
description: Interim pre-stability release-snapshot for the CROSS+WALKRI JSON Schema family. Names the compatible set of schema versions that operate together in this snapshot. Instance documents conforming to this snapshot declare round_identity.conforms_to = 'cross-walkri/release@0.1.0'.

round-identity.role: shared sub-schema; join key across cohorts

round-config.role: funder cohort; published at Commit stage

runbook.role: operator cohort; operationalizes Commit through Register stages

applicant-facing-publication.role: applicant cohort; published at Commit, used through List

x-cross-walkri-not-yet-included: cross-walkri/form-spec@0.1.0 (deferred to release v1.1 per architecture document)
x-cross-walkri-compatibility-rule: Within this snapshot, all member schemas are compatible. Instance documents must use only the versions named above. A schema major-version change in any member produces a new snapshot (release@0.2.0 or release@1.0 depending on scope).
x-cross-walkri-conformance-test: A round instance conforms to release@0.1.0 when (1) the Round Identity sub-schema in the instance matches round-identity@0.1.0; (2) each cohort-specific schema instance matches the version named in this manifest; (3) all $ref cross-references resolve to schemas in this manifest; (4) the round_identity.conforms_to declaration names 'cross-walkri/release@0.1.0'.

x-cross-walkri-changelog.summary: Initial interim pre-stability release-snapshot. Names round-identity@0.1.0, round-config@0.2.0, runbook@0.2.0, applicant-facing-publication@0.2.0 as compatible members. Established to address Consistency Audit Finding 2 (the Octant Epoch 13 instance previously referenced release@1.0 which had not been declared).
